title: November 1975 helicopter near-miss with a ghost rocket, in declassified files
summary: Clas Svahn tells of November 1975 helicopter near-miss with a ghost rocket, in declassified files, about November 7, 1975 at Swedish–Norwegian border region, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: The helicopter pilot's account of the ghost rocket

plain: A Swedish UFO researcher, Clas Svahn, says he recently got clearance to see files from a Swedish military, customs and police operation of the 1970s, papers meant to stay sealed until 2040. Among them, he says, is the case of a helicopter pilot near the Swedish and Norwegian border on November 7, 1975, flying 20 meters over the treetops on a moonlit, snowy night, who nearly collided with a "ghost rocket," the name for rocket-like objects people reported in Scandinavian skies. He tells it because the files would show the state took these objects seriously.
